tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
D CORE 40G QSFP+ OT-QSFP+LR20 1270~1330nm (Single Mode) Duplex LC 20KM SFP Module

The D CORE 40G QSFP+ OT-QSFP+LR20 is a high-performance 40G QSFP+ (Quad Small Form-Factor Pluggable Plus) transceiver designed for long-range data transmission over single-mode fiber (SMF). Operating within a wavelength range of 1270~1330nm, this module provides a reliable and efficient solution for high-speed networking applications. Equipped with a Duplex LC connector, this transceiver ensures seamless data transmission over distances of up to 20 kilometers, making it ideal for use in data centers, enterprise networks, and telecom applications. The Distributed Feedback (DFB) CWDM transmitter ensures stable signal performance, while the PIN receiver provides high sensitivity with a receiver sensitivity of <-12.5dBm. With a maximum data rate of 40Gbps, the module supports QSFP+ MSA and SFF-8436 protocols, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of networking equipment. It features an extinction ratio of >3.5dB, offering superior signal integrity. The transmit power ranges from -4.5 to 2.3dBm, while the receiver overload is rated at 3.3dBm, providing a power budget of 8dB. Designed for efficiency, the D CORE 40G QSFP+ LR20 has a power consumption of ≤3.5W, making it an energy-efficient choice for high-speed networks. It operates within a commercial temperature range of 0 to 70°C (32 to 158°F), ensuring durability in various environments. Manufactured by FS, this transceiver is engineered for high-speed, long-distance connectivity, making it an excellent choice for businesses looking to enhance their networking infrastructure with reliable, high-performance optical modules.

D CORE 40G QSFP+ OT-QSFP+LR20 1270~1330nm Duplex LC 20KM SFP Module Features

  • High-Speed Data Transmission – Supports a maximum data rate of 40Gbps, making it ideal for high-performance networking applications.
  • Long Transmission Distance – Designed for single-mode fiber (SMF), allowing data transmission up to 20 kilometers, making it suitable for long-distance communication.
  • Wide Wavelength Range – Operates within a 1270~1330nm wavelength range, ensuring stable and efficient optical signal transmission.
  • Duplex LC Connector – Uses a Duplex LC interface, providing a secure and efficient fiber optic connection for seamless data transmission.
  • Efficient Transmitter and Receiver – Equipped with a DFB CWDM transmitter and PIN receiver, ensuring strong signal performance with high sensitivity.
  • Low Power Consumption – Consumes ≤3.5W, making it an energy-efficient choice for data centers and enterprise networks.
  • Reliable Optical Performance – Features a TX power range of -4.5 to 2.3dBm, a receiver sensitivity of <-12.5dBm, and a receiver overload of 3.3dBm, ensuring high-quality signal integrity.
  • Strong Power Budget – Provides an 8dB power budget, optimizing transmission performance for long-distance connections.
  • Wide Operating Temperature Range – Functions within a commercial temperature range of 0 to 70°C (32 to 158°F), ensuring durability in various environmental conditions.
  • Compliance with Industry Standards – Supports QSFP+ MSA and SFF-8436 protocols, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of networking equipment.
  • Reliable Vendor – Manufactured by FS, a trusted brand known for producing high-quality optical transceiver modules.
  • Ideal for Various Applications – Suitable for use in data centers, enterprise networks, cloud computing, and telecommunication infrastructures.
